cc:Work.dc:description: Compact two-panel TSDF teaching diagram with the same linear metric depth scale. d=2 m; mu=0.2 m; clip((d-z)/mu,-1,1) only for 0<=z<=d+mu. A=1.5 m:+1; B=1.9 m:+0.5; C=2.0 m:0; D=2.1 m:-0.5; E=2.5 m:unknown. The curve ends at 2.2 m. E has weight zero and no value on the curve. All values and marker coordinates are computed; no external data.
